description: This file defines a web scraper class for Quaker Oats recipes, extracting metadata, ingredients, instructions, and other recipe details from the website quakeroats.com.

classes.name: QuakerOats
classes.description: A scraper class for extracting recipe data from quakeroats.com

methods.name: host
methods.description: Returns the host domain for the scraper, 'quakeroats.com'.

methods.name: author
methods.description: Returns the author of the recipe, 'The Quaker Oats Company'.

methods.name: title
methods.description: Extracts and normalizes the recipe title from the page.

methods.name: _get_metadata_from_span
methods.description: Helper method to extract text from a span element with a specific partial id.

methods.name: prep_time
methods.description: Extracts preparation time in minutes from the page.

methods.name: cook_time
methods.description: Extracts cooking time in minutes from the page.

methods.name: yields
methods.description: Returns the number of servings or yield of the recipe.

methods.name: total_time
methods.description: Calculates total time by summing prep and cook times.

methods.name: ingredients
methods.description: Extracts a list of ingredients with quantities from the recipe page.

methods.name: ingredient_groups
methods.description: Groups ingredients based on specific HTML structure.

methods.name: instructions
methods.description: Extracts and joins recipe instructions into a single string.

methods.name: description
methods.description: Extracts the meta description of the recipe.
